criterion: Primary CTA: obviously the next step
description: A fresh Control view shows four setup forms (T3 credential, Projects, Map a T3 thread, Register Cloud context) with equal-weight full-width grey buttons and no next-step call-out. The forms depend on each other (pair, then save a project, then map), but nothing says so. The Map form is fully interactive with an empty Project select.
expected: One call-out such as "Step 1 of 3: pair T3", with later forms disabled or collapsed until their prerequisite exists.
actual: Every form is shown and enabled at once, and nothing indicates order.
suggested_fix: Show a setup checklist (Pair T3 → Save a project → Map a thread) driven by the snapshot. Collapse or disable later steps until earlier ones are done.

description: Read T3 now with no credential paired gives no feedback. Before and after screenshots are identical apart from the button focus ring.
expected: A transient "Reading…" state, and with no credential a message such as "Pair T3 first: nothing to read" (or the button disabled).
suggested_fix: Disable Read T3 now while the credential is missing, or show the poll result ("Read just now · no threads mapped").

description: Section headings in Control settings leave large empty bands. Each h3 is followed by about 37 px before its intro text, and the Projects h3 is followed by a 74 px empty band (an empty project list) before the Project ID label.
expected: An 8–16 px heading-to-content gap, and no reserved space for an empty list.
actual: Measured: h3 'Projects' at y=587, first label at about y=681. 'T3 credential' at y=285, intro text at y=342.
suggested_fix: Do not render the empty list (or render an inline "No projects yet" line), and reduce the margins on the section intro paragraph.

description: The Authorized tasks and Authorized senders checkboxes are about 12 px native checkboxes with 17 px row spacing, inside unstyled native fieldsets that do not match the rounded dark inputs above them.
expected: Rows of at least 32–44 px with styled checkboxes that match the form's input style.
actual: Rows are tightly packed native checkboxes, and the fieldset has a default grey bevel border.
suggested_fix: Style the pickers as a list of 36–44 px rows with full-row labels, and match the input border and radius.

description: The two status lines are styled differently. The T3 status ("T3 credential: missing · …") uses 13 px small text, while the Cursor Cloud status ("Live dispatch disabled · …") uses 16 px body text. "No T3 threads are mapped yet." is centred while all other content is left-aligned.
expected: One status-line style for both providers, and empty states aligned with their section.
actual: Two sizes, and a centred empty-state line.
suggested_fix: Use one status component for T3 and Cloud, and left-align the empty state.

description: Control's "Projects" (control project ID, name, repository) sits under the header's Pardner project "Ledgerline" with no explanation of how the two relate, and the agent enrolled by `client agent-grant` appears as "Setup agent".
expected: A label such as "T3/GitHub project for this controller" that says how it relates to the Pardner project, prefilled from it.
actual: A second, unexplained "project" concept, with all fields empty.
suggested_fix: Rename it to "Repositories" or "Control projects", prefill the name from the Pardner project, and explain it in one line.
